summary: Master project control with our comprehensive training course. Gain the skills needed to ensure project success and improve your management capabilities.
lede: Project control compares approved plans with actual progress and forecasts so teams can spot deviations and decide on corrective action. This course is for project practitioners, control specialists, delivery managers, and governance leaders who create, review, or approve performance information. It develops practical skills in building integrated WBS-based baselines, analyzing CPM schedules and EVM indicators, assessing change impacts, forecasting costs, and reporting through dashboards.
audienceIntro: This project control course is designed for professionals who create, validate, use, or approve project performance information. It supports hands-on practitioners, control specialists, delivery managers, and governance leaders who need to connect schedule, cost, risk, change, and executive reporting.
prerequisites: Preparation: Review a recent project schedule, cost report, or progress update if your confidentiality rules permit. Technology: Bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet files. Power BI Desktop supports the dashboard lab where installation is permitted; browser or demonstration alternatives support restricted environments. Microsoft Project and Oracle Primavera P6 licences remain optional because the instructor can demonstrate scheduling workflows using prepared files and screenshots. Programming: Coding requirement is none. Advanced schedule risk simulation and AI-assisted variance analysis receive conceptual awareness and operational interpretation rather than technical engineering depth.
